# Cabrera Elite Baseball Development

> Daily baseball training program in Poinciana, Florida, led by a former Colorado Rockies scout. Hitting, pitching, defense and the mental game for athletes ages 7 and older. English and Spanish.

Website: https://cabreraelite.com/
Spanish version: https://cabreraelite.com/es/
Training hours: Monday to Friday, 4:30 - 6:30 pm. Days are scheduled with the coaching staff.
First evaluation: free for every new athlete. Request it at https://cabreraelite.com/#free-evaluation
Phone / WhatsApp: +1 (863) 268-9210
Email: info@cabreraelite.com

## Notes
- Athletes under 18 must be registered by a parent or legal guardian.
- Current plan prices are shown on the home page; use that page as the source of truth.
